name: Gitingest
summary: Turns any Git repository into a prompt-ready text digest for LLMs, as a web app, CLI or Python package.
description: Paste a repository URL or run the CLI/Python package to get one plain-text digest of a codebase: a repository summary with token counts, the directory tree and each file's contents, sized for an LLM context window. Private repositories work with a GitHub token; include/exclude patterns, branch selection and max file size filter the output. Self-hosting with Docker and browser extensions are also provided.
contains: web UI, CLI (pip install) and Python package
output: repository summary, directory structure and file contents with token counts
private repositories via GitHub personal access token
include/exclude patterns, branch selection and max file size
replace 'hub' with 'ingest' in any GitHub URL
self-host with Docker; Chrome extension and Firefox add-on
